sections.title: Sample Dialogue
sections.content:
Sample Dialogue
Read the following conversation. Pay attention to how the speakers make suggestions.
Steve:
Hi, Jenny, would you like to do something with me this weekend?
Jenny:
Sure. What shall we do?
Steve:
I don't know. Do you have any ideas?
Jenny:
Why don't we see a film?
Steve:
That sounds good to me. Which film shall we see?
Jenny:
Let's see Action Man 4.
Steve:
I'd rather not. I don't like violent films. How about going to Mad Doctor Brown? I
hear it's quite a funny film.
Jenny:
OK. Let's go see that. When is it on?
Steve:
It's at 8 o'clock at the Rex. Shall we have a bite to eat before the film?
Jenny:
Sure, that sounds great. What about going to that new Italian restaurant
Michetti's?
Steve:
Great idea! Let's meet there at six.
Jenny:
OK. I'll see you at Michetti's at six. Bye.
Steve:
Bye.

sections.title: Sample Dialogue
sections.content:
Sample Dialogue
Read the following conversation. Pay attention to how the speakers give compliments.
Jenny:
I absolutely love what you're wearing today.
Steve:
You do? I just bought this outfit a couple of days ago.
Jenny:
Seriously, it looks really nice on you. Where did you buy it?
Steve:
I bought it from the Macy's at the Santa Anita mall.
Jenny:
I really like that outfit.
Steve:
Thanks. I think you look nice today, too.
Jenny:
Thank you. I just bought these new shoes earlier today.
Steve:
Those are nice. What are they?
Jenny:
These are some Chucks.
Steve:
Those are great. How much were they?
Jenny:
I got them for forty.
Steve: I think I might go and find me my own pair of Chucks.

Read the following conversation. Pay attention to how the speakers make, accept or refuse an
invitation.
Steve:
Would you like to go out to dinner tonight, Jenny?
Jenny:
That would be very nice. Have you got anywhere particular in mind?
Steve:
I was wondering if you'd like to go to that new Japanese restaurant that's opened
on Elm Avenue.
Jenny:
I'd rather go somewhere else, if you don't mind. I really don't feel like that ... all
that raw fish.
Steve:
What about going to a Chinese restaurant in Chinatown?
Jenny:
I'd like that very much. What sort of time?
Steve:
Shall we make it 6:00 in front of the library?
Jenny:
6:00 in front of the library. Yes, that's fine.
Steve:
Good. That'll give me a chance to take any library books back before we meet.
See you later.

Steve:
Would you agree that Australian English and British English are very similar?

I'm not sure I quite agree.

Oh, what's your experience, then?

I'd just like to say that they're very different. It's true that Australians speak

their accent.

Well, you have a point there, but not all Australians speak with a strong accent.

Really?
Steve:
Yes, you see, generally speaking, the more highly educated they are, the less
typically Australian their speech is.

Yes, you're quite right.

Mr Green:
Do you know how late it is?

My fault. I didn't realize what time it was.

I hope you don't think that excuse lets you off the hook.

Not really. I'm telling the truth.

Haven't I asked you to call if you're going to be home late?

This is true, but it must have slipped my mind.

Regardless, all you had to do was give a call.

I know. I should have called.

Come home late one more time, and you'll find your stuff outside.

You want to throw me out over this?

That's fine, because if I leave, then your rules won't matter.

Life Without Limits
Imagine being born without arms. No arms to wrap around someone, no hands to
experience touch, or to hold another hand with. Or what about being born without legs? Having
no ability to dance, walk, run, or even stand on two feet. Now put both of those scenarios
together: no arms and no legs. What would you do? How would that affect your everyday life?
Born in 1982 in Melbourne, Australia, without any medical explanation or warning,
Nicholas Vujicic came into the world with neither arms nor legs. Having had an uneventful
pregnancy and no family history to expect this condition, imagine the shock his parents felt
when they saw their first born, brand new baby boy, only to find he was what the world would
consider imperfect and abnormal. How would their son live a normal, happy life? What could
he ever do or become when living with what the world would see as such a massive disability?
Li le did they know that this beautiful limbless baby would one day be someone who would
inspire and motivate people from all walks of life, touching lives all over the world.

第一部分：阅读判断（第1~10题，每题1分，共10分）
下面的短文后列出了10个句子，请根据短文的内容对每个句子作出判断：如果该句
提供的是正确信息，选择A；如果该句提供的是错误信息，选择B；如果该句的信息文中
没有提及，选择C。
Work Is a Service
Young people may ask themselves questions like this when they apply for employment:
"What are my working hours? What are my extra benefits besides wages? What holidays will
I have off? Will I have enough time to hang out with my friends or pursue my hobbies?" With
questions like these, however, when we focus on our leisure hours instead of our working hours,
we may be prevented from seeing a much greater opportunity.
Good work attitudes, habits, and skills are learned through successful work experiences. Let
me illustrate. On the ranch (牧场) where I grew up, the cows had to be milked before dawn every
day. When I was just 10 years old, I would enter our barnyard where there were about 10 to 12
cows waiting for me to let them into the milking barn. My mother and father used to say out loud
to the cows, "Good morning. It's good to see you!" I have to confess that as a young boy I didn't
feel quite the same way toward the cows.
After each cow was milked, I poured the milk from the pail into a 10-gallon can. Each can
weighed about 80 pounds when full. It made me stretch my young muscles as I carried them to
the road for the dairy to pick up.
My father and mother quite frequently helped me with milking the cows. I remember my
father and mother continued to milk until they were in their late 80s. But Father didn't milk the
cows because he had to; he milked them because they needed to be milked. There is a difference.
To him, these animals were not just cows — they were Big Blackie and Bossie and Sally and
Betsy. He wanted them to be content. He always said that contented cows give good milk. To my
father, milking cows — as unsophisticated as it may seem —— was not an extra burden; it was an
opportunity. Milking was not a job for him; it was a service.
This philosophy is something that helped me as I grew up. It helped me to find out that all
honest work is honorable. Within a few years I realized that routinely performing these chores
actually began to give me a sense of confidence and empowerment. I took pride in my work. We
control our own attitudes towards work. Self-confidence and empowerment can serve us well —
in the classroom or on Wall Street.

第二部分：阅读选择（第11~15题，每题2分，共10分）
阅读下面短文，请从短文后所给各题的4个选项（A、B、C、D）中选出1个最佳选项。
Friendship and Loyalty
When the terrorist attack on September 11th caused people to flee the building, Avremel
Zelmanowitz risked his own chance of escape by staying behind with his friend and colleague,
Ed Beyea, who was confined to a wheelchair due to a paralysis known as quadriplegia (四肢截
瘫). Both men lost their lives, but the story of Avremel's love and devotion to his friend conveys a
life-giving message to all.
Avremel never married, and he shared a house with his brother and his family. He was a
loving uncle to his brother's children, and he was devoted to caring for his aging parents. He
was a "family man" in every sense of the word. At the same time, he had his own life, his Torah
classes, his varied interests, and a job and friends to which he was characteristically devoted.
When the tragedy occurred, Avremel was age 55, and his friend, Ed Beyea, was age 42.Ed
became disabled after a diving accident at age 22, but he managed to work 14 years at Blue Cross
Blue Shield since his injury. Both he and Avremel were program analysts who worked on the 27th
floor of the World Trade Center.
Avremel had joined the office two years after Ed was hired, and the two became very close
friends. They both loved books and music — often trading books and tapes, and they both served
as the special uncle of their respective families. Like Avremel, Ed had no children of his own, but
he was a father figure to his two nephews after their father died. Both friends had a great sense of
humor, although Ed was strong and outgoing, while Avremel was the more quiet of the pair.
On the morning of September 11th, Ed wanted to wait until he could be securely carried
down by several rescue workers, as it was dangerous for someone with his disability to be moved.
Avremel wouldn't allow his friend to wait alone when everyone else was fleeing the building, and
he stayed with him.
In the days that followed, the media learned about Avremel's selfless act, and the story
began to spread. President Bush, in his national prayer address to the American people,
referred to Avremel's act as one of the many "eloquent (有说服力的) acts of sacrifice" that were
demonstrated by Americans during this crisis.
184

第三部分：概括段落大意和补全句子（第16~25题，每题1分，共10分）
阅读下面短文，请完成短文后的2项测试任务：(1)从第16~20题后所给的6个选项
中为第①~⑤段每段选择1个正确的小标题；(2)从第21~25 题后所给的6个选项中选择
5个正确选项，分别完成每个句子。
Five Reasons to Celebrate Mistakes
1 Mistakes have a way of focusing our attention and putting crucial problems right in our face.
Mistakes light a path for us. When we own up to our mistakes, we often know exactly what's not
working and what we can do to fix it.
2 There is one sure way to avoid mistakes and that's to avoid life. The writer who never
finishes a book will never have to worry about getting negative reviews. The comedian who
never performs in front of an audience is sure to avoid telling jokes that fall flat. When we
are comfortable with making mistakes, we're more likely to take risks and tackle projects.
Celebrating mistakes involves wisdom. Effective people don't set goals with the idea of making
mistakes. Instead, they aim to reach those goals while accepting the risk of error.
3 Imagine working at a company that has no standards — where mistakes are not distinguished
from successes and no one is held accountable for errors. We could turn in the most careless
and the crudest pieces of work we'd ever done, and they would get treated the same as our best
work. We'd never be able to count on having the supplies we needed because no one would
complain when vendors failed to deliver. Projects could go permanently unfinished and no one
would say anything. In an atmosphere where there's no difference between failure and success,
the word "mistake" would be without meaning. Mistakes can happen only when people are truly
committed to making things work.
4 The word "mistake" derives meaning only by comparison to what we desire. Noticing and
admitting our mistakes reminds us of what we really want to have, do, and be. Mistakes offer us
an opportunity to practice truth telling. With this act come the rewards of honesty and frankness,
including self-knowledge and the capacity for change. As we tell the truth about our mistakes, we
can benefit by releasing shame and blame. Fixing mistakes and preventing them from happening
again are key goals.
5 Mistakes are usually more instructive than successes — and often far more interesting. The
lessons we learn from making mistakes often stick with us for a lifetime. We can translate those
lessons into new values and behaviors that make a profound difference. With all these potential
benefits from mistakes, we have plenty of reasons to celebrate them.
186

Booking Online and Saving the Environment
When you are looking to book a holiday, it is unlikely that you will think about how green
your booking decision is, but it is definitely something that should be taken into consideration. By
"green，，we are of course talking about the impact on the environment.
When looking to book a holiday, you will probably find that you are faced with two main
decisions. The first is to go into a travel agency, pick up a stack ofbrochures halfthe size of a person,
read through them and go back with just the one and book with the travel agents directly or over the
phone. The second is to miss out the shops and brochures altogether and go onto the Internet.
The Internet holds many advantages over the high street travel agents, the main one being
convenience. You can go online to look at holidays at any time ofthe day, whether it is in that 20
minutes before work starts in the morning, half an hour at your desk at lunchtime or even at home
on your laptop in ont of the television at night. There are no time constraints to going online,
while the travel agents are usually massively busy at times when people can actually go, i.e. lunch
hours or at the weekend. You could use the telephone but you wouldn’t be able to see the pictures
or all the details ofthe holidays, so you would probably be sent a brochure anyway.
There are websites on the Internet that make shopping for holiday deals much easier. These
websites are known as price comparison websites. Icelolly, Travel Supermarket and Deal Checker
are examples of some of the best-known price comparison sites to look for cheap holiday deals,
and they essentially search through lots of different tour operators so that you don’t have to. The
results are then displayed on one page from which you can book, meaning that you don’t even
need a lot oftime to do this. -
The contrast with the travel agencies is that you probably have to take two trips, with
brochure reading in between, and this is where the green side of things comes in. The piles and
piles of brochures are definitely not green, and the amount of unnecessary paper used can’t be
good for the environment. In the days of the Internet, smartphone, tablets and computers, there
is really no need for such a large amount of paper to be wasted. So not only will it save you time
and effort to book online, it will do a little bit towards saving the environment too!

Why Lack of Sleep Could Be Making You Fatter
Sleepless nights don’t just min your mood e next day they could also damage your
waistline. According to new research in the August issue of the American Journal of Clinical
Nutrition sleep deprivation can cause people to pack on extra pounds.
Researchers at the New York Obesity Nutrition Research Centre at St. Luke’s- oosevelt
Hospital found that sleep-deprived people seem to bum the same number of calories as the well￾rested, but they consume about 300 more calories a day. Given that it takes just 3,500 calories to
add a pound to your body, those calories can quickly turn into extra weight.
But there are several other reasons that sleep loss could lead to weight gain, says sleep
disorder specialist Michael Breus. When we get too little shut-eye, our metabolism ( )
slows down to conserve energy. That slowdown triggers the release of the hormone cortisol (
尔蒙皮质 ) which increases appetite. Your body thinks it needs more energy, so it asks for more
food.
In a vicious cycle, sleep loss also causes our bodies to release more ghrelin, another
hormone that signals hunger, and less leptin, the hormone that tells your stomach that it’s full.
With your hormones no longer working in the normal way, your body wants more food and lacks
the sensitivity to know when to stop eating. Not to mention that being awake more hours gives
you more time to snack.
"The later you’re up at night, the greater the likelihood that you’re going to eat,’’ Breus says,
and "you’re more likely to eat high-fat, high-carb foods.’’
One other contributing factor to such weight gain is that the body bums the most calories
during REM sleep, a deeply restful phase. Less sleep means less time in REM.
For optimal health, experts say you should try to get 7.5 hours of sleep a night. If you have
trouble sleeping, stick to a nightly routine, exercise during the day, banish worries to a journal,
and keep pre-bedtime activities relaxing.

vocabulary.meaning: pron.某物；某事；想来重要（或值得注意）的事物
vocabulary.englishDefinition: n. Anything unknown, undetermined, or not specifically； designated; a certain indefinite thing; an indeterminate or unknown； event; an unspecified task, work, or thing.；n. A part; a portion, more or less; an indefinite quantity； or degree; a little.；n. A perso
vocabulary.example: Team work in sports offers a way for people to compete for something together.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 体育运动中的团队合作为人们一起竞争提供了一种方式。

vocabulary.meaning: n. 了不起的人, 大人物；pron. 有人, 某人
vocabulary.englishDefinition: n a human being
vocabulary.example: somebody
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: somebody：n. 了不起的人, 大人物；pron. 有人, 某人

vocabulary.meaning: n.人；人们；人民；百姓
vocabulary.englishDefinition: n. (plural) any group of human beings (men or women or children) collectively；n. members of a family line；v. fill with people；v. furnish with people
vocabulary.example: People usually think leasing a car can save money.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 人们通常会认为租车能省钱。

vocabulary.meaning: 尤其; 特别；格外
vocabulary.englishDefinition: more with one person, thing, etc. than with others, or more in particular circumstances than in others
vocabulary.example: Generations of children ,especially minority kids, have been educated according to the theory that they lack self-esteem.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 一代又一代的孩子，尤其是少数民族的孩子，都是根据他们缺乏自尊的理论来接受教育的。

vocabulary.meaning: n.方式；方法；途径；路 adv.很远；大量；非常；极其
vocabulary.englishDefinition: n. the condition of things generally；. a course of conduct；. any artifact consisting of a road or path affording passage from one place to another；. a journey or passage
vocabulary.example: Actually, to be happy with yourself, all you need to do is to change the way you see your body.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 事实上，要想对自己感到快乐，你所需要做的就是改变你看待自己身体的方式。

vocabulary.meaning: v.成为；适合；合计；等于；v.制造；做
vocabulary.englishDefinition: v. engage in；v. give certain properties to something；v. make or cause to be or to become；v. compel or make somebody or something to act in a certain way
vocabulary.example: People go to travel agencies and make their decisions directly.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 人们会去旅行社，并直接做决定。

vocabulary.meaning: n.人；人员；个人
vocabulary.englishDefinition: n. a human being；n. a human body (usually including the clothing)；n. a grammatical category used in the classification of pronouns, possessive determiners, and verb forms according to whether they indicate the speaker, the addressee, or a third party
vocabulary.example: Additionally these reactions can help a person comfort himself through touch.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 另外，这些反应可以帮助一个人通过抚摸来安慰自己。

vocabulary.meaning: adv.什么时候；何时
vocabulary.englishDefinition: adv. At what time; -- used interrogatively.；adv. At what time; at, during, or after the time that; at or；just after, the moment that; -- used relatively.；adv. While; whereas; although; -- used in the manner of a；conjunction to introduce a dependent adverbial s
vocabulary.example: There are two main choices when people look to book their holidays.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 当人们想要预订假期时，主要有两种选择。

vocabulary.meaning: adj.讲究；挑剔；专指的
vocabulary.englishDefinition: n. a fact about some part (as opposed to general)；n. (logic) a proposition that asserts something about some (but not all) members of a class；s. unique or specific to a person or thing or category；s. separate and distinct from others of the same group or categ
vocabulary.example: One thing that has struck me in particular in France is personal interactions with each other.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 法国人尤其使我震惊的一点就是他们的人际互动。

vocabulary.meaning: adv.好 n.好处；好人；益处；善行；adj.有好处；好的；优质的；符合标准的
vocabulary.englishDefinition: n. benefit；n. moral excellence or admirableness；n. that which is pleasing or valuable or useful；a. having desirable or positive qualities especially those suitable for a thing specified
vocabulary.example: And I resolved to list the good things in my life.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 我决心把生活中美好的事情列出来。

vocabulary.meaning: n.时间；时候；次
vocabulary.englishDefinition: n. an instance or single occasion for some event；. a period of time considered as a resource under your control and sufficient to accomplish something；. an indefinite period (usually marked by specific attributes or activities)；. a suitable moment
vocabulary.example: That doesn’t leave much time for chatting about the weather or your mood.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 那就没有多少时间了谈论天气或心情。

vocabulary.meaning: adv.如何；怎样；多么；询问健康状况
vocabulary.englishDefinition: adv. In what manner or way; by what means or process.；adv. To what degree or extent, number or amount; in what； proportion; by what measure or quality.；adv. For what reason; from what cause.；adv. In what state, condition, or plight.；adv. By what name, designat
vocabulary.example: But how do they do that?
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 但他们是怎么做到的呢?

vocabulary.meaning: a. 真实的, 正确的, 忠诚的, 可靠的, 纯粹的, 正式的；. 真实, 准确；adv. 真实地, 准确地
vocabulary.englishDefinition: n. proper alignment; the property possessed by something that is in correct or proper alignment；v. make level, square, balanced, or concentric；a. consistent with fact or reality; not false；s. accurately placed or thrown
vocabulary.example: How many of us recognize true loyalty in a friend?
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 教材原句理解：本句包含 “true”，核心义为“a. 真实的, 正确的, 忠诚的, 可靠的, 纯粹的, 正式的；. 真实, 准确；adv. 真实地, 准确地”。

vocabulary.meaning: n.生命；寿命；一生
vocabulary.englishDefinition: n. a characteristic state or mode of living；n. the experience of being alive; the course of human events and activities；n. the course of existence of an individual; the actions and events that occur in living；n. the period during which something is functional
vocabulary.example: Farm life still requires a lot of hard work and sacrifice.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 农场生活依然需要许多艰苦的工作和牺牲。

vocabulary.meaning: 可获得的；可 购得的；可找到的
vocabulary.englishDefinition: (of things) that you can get, buy or find
vocabulary.example: there are fewer resources and support available to those running small businesses.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 那些经营小企业的人获得的资源和支持越来越少。

vocabulary.meaning: 质量；品质
vocabulary.englishDefinition: the standard of something when it is compared to other things like it; how good or bad sth is
vocabulary.example: Famous brand products are of better quality.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 名牌产品质量好。

vocabulary.meaning: v.使用；利用；运用；消耗 n.使用；用途；用法；使用权
vocabulary.englishDefinition: n. the act of using；. a particular service；. (law) the exercise of the legal right to enjoy the benefits of owning property；v. put into service; make work or employ for a particular purpose or for its inherent or natural purpose
vocabulary.example: He discovered new ways to use plants.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 他发现了利用植物的新方法。

vocabulary.meaning: v.喜欢；adj.像这样；prep.比如；adv.好像n.爱好
vocabulary.englishDefinition: n. a similar kind；. a kind of person；v. find enjoyable or agreeable；v. be fond of
vocabulary.example: I like making friends with people around me.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 我喜欢和周围的朋友做朋友。

vocabulary.meaning: adj.其他；另一个；另外；对面；pron.另外一个
vocabulary.englishDefinition: a. not the same one or ones already mentioned or implied；s. recently past；s. very unusual; different in character or quality from the normal or expected
vocabulary.example: Team work teaches people how to help each other and encourage each other.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 团队合作教会人们如何互相帮助，如何互相鼓励。

vocabulary.meaning: n.情况；〈正式〉工作；地点
vocabulary.englishDefinition: n. the general state of things; the combination of circumstances at a given time；n. a condition or position in which you find yourself；n. a complex or critical or unusual difficulty
vocabulary.example: They can interact with people in familiar situations, and they feel they can interact with people as adults.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 他们可以在熟悉的情况下与人互动，他们觉得自己可以像成年人一样与人互动。

vocabulary.meaning: 自信心；把握
vocabulary.englishDefinition: a belief in your own ability to do things and be successful
vocabulary.example: But as my turn to speak approached, my confidence decreased.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 但当轮到我发言时，我的信心下降了。

vocabulary.meaning: adv.起床；向上；出现；到 prep.沿着；向；顺着
vocabulary.englishDefinition: v. raise；a. being or moving higher in position or greater in some value; being above a former position or level；s. extending or moving toward a higher place；s. (usually followed by `on' or `for') in readiness
vocabulary.example: Chemicals for farming first came up at the turn of the 20th century .
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 农业用化学品最早出现在20世纪之交。

vocabulary.meaning: 所需的
vocabulary.englishDefinition: help that you need to perform a particular task (
vocabulary.example: It is aids digestion and treating bowel disorders.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 它有助于消化和治疗肠道疾病。

vocabulary.meaning: 想法；看法； 主意；记忆
vocabulary.englishDefinition: something that you think of or remember
vocabulary.example: I thought reading would help me get to sleep.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 我以为读书能帮助我入睡。

vocabulary.meaning: n.钱；财富；钞票
vocabulary.englishDefinition: n. the most common medium of exchange; functions as legal tender；n. wealth reckoned in terms of money；n. the official currency issued by a government or national bank
vocabulary.example: People usually think leasing a car can save money.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 人们通常会认为租车能省钱。

vocabulary.meaning: adv.出去；外出；离开；出于；n.出路
vocabulary.englishDefinition: n. (baseball) a failure by a batter or runner to reach a base safely in baseball；v. reveal (something) about somebody's identity or lifestyle；v. be made known; be disclosed or revealed；a. not allowed to continue to bat or run
vocabulary.example: They prepare lesson plans, give out homework, and make up tests.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 他们准备教学计划，布置作业，还要组织考试。

vocabulary.meaning: 观点；态度；立场
vocabulary.englishDefinition: an opinion on or an attitude towards a particular subject
vocabulary.example: The most important secret to happiness is to be grateful for the good things in your life-whatever may be your financial position.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 幸福最重要的秘诀就是对生活中的美好事物心存感激——不管你的经济状况如何。

vocabulary.meaning: n.自我；本人；本来面目；个性
vocabulary.englishDefinition: n. your consciousness of your own identity；. a person considered as a unique individual；a. (used as a combining form) relating to--of or by or to or from or for--the self
vocabulary.example: Ulrich said it is a self comforting gesture to help people in the moment.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 乌尔里希说此时去帮助别人是一种自我安慰的姿势。

vocabulary.meaning: v.拥有；承认；adj.本人的；自己做的
vocabulary.englishDefinition: v. have ownership or possession of；s. belonging to or on behalf of a specified person (especially yourself); preceded by a possessive
vocabulary.example: This enables elderly people to remain in their own houses.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 这可以让老年人继续待在他们自己的房子里。

vocabulary.meaning: 悄悄疾行；溜
vocabulary.englishDefinition: to go somewhere quickly and quietly, especially without being noticed
vocabulary.example: 12. He got the milk spilt all over the kitchen floor because he_____________ . A. dropped the bottle B. was naughty C slipped and fell 12.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 他把牛奶洒了一地，因为他_____________。 A.瓶子掉了 B.是淘气的 C. 滑倒了

vocabulary.meaning: 机会；时机
vocabulary.englishDefinition: a time when a particular situation makes it possible to do or achieve something
vocabulary.example: My brother took every opportunity to promote himself.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 我哥哥一有机会就会推销自己。

vocabulary.meaning: n.进程；流程；工序；v.处理；加工；审核
vocabulary.englishDefinition: n. (psychology) the performance of some composite cognitive activity; an operation that affects mental contents；n. a mental process that you are not directly aware of；n. a natural prolongation or projection from a part of an organism either animal or plant；n.
vocabulary.example: Proper dog training is not a “quick—it is an ongoing process.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 适当的狗训练不是“快速的——它是一个持续的过程”。

vocabulary.meaning: n. 站立, 站住, 停顿, 讲台, 看台, 立场, 法院证人席；vi. 站, 立, 坐落, 停滞, 位于, 坚持, 维持原状；vt. 忍受, 使站立, 抵挡

vocabulary.meaning: 说明；说法；表态
vocabulary.englishDefinition: something that you say or write that gives information or an opinion
vocabulary.example: statement
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: statement：说明；说法；表态

vocabulary.meaning: adj.重要的；有重大影响的；有巨大价值的；影响很大的
vocabulary.englishDefinition: a. of great significance or value；s. having or suggesting a consciousness of high position
vocabulary.example: Now many people consider it unimportant.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 现在许多人认为它不重要。

vocabulary.meaning: 作出反应；响应
vocabulary.englishDefinition: to do something as a reaction to something that somebody has said or done
vocabulary.example: He responded that it all came from an experience when he was about two.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 他回答说，这一切都来自于他两岁时的一次经历。

vocabulary.meaning: n.工作；作品；劳动；功 v.劳动；干活；奏效；运行
vocabulary.englishDefinition: n. activity directed toward making or doing something；. a product produced or accomplished through the effort or activity or agency of a person or thing；. (physics) a manifestation of energy; the transfer of energy from one physical system to another expressed
vocabulary.example: hard work and devotion.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 努力工作和奉献精神。

vocabulary.meaning: 绝望；拼命；铤而走险
vocabulary.englishDefinition: the state of being desperate

vocabulary.exampleTranslation: desperation：绝望；拼命；铤而走险

vocabulary.meaning: n.感觉；感情
vocabulary.englishDefinition: n. the experiencing of affective and emotional states；n. a physical sensation that you experience；n. an intuitive understanding of something
vocabulary.example: And I'm not alone in feeling this way
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 我不是唯一一个有这种感觉的人;

vocabulary.meaning: 抱怨
vocabulary.englishDefinition: to complain about something in a way that other people find annoying
vocabulary.example: Do we want to moan about them or solve them?
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 教材原句理解：本句包含 “moan”，核心义为“抱怨”。

vocabulary.meaning: 众多; 大量

vocabulary.meaning: n/v.照顾照料，关心关怀
vocabulary.englishDefinition: n. the work of providing treatment for or attending to someone or something；n. a cause for feeling concern；n. attention and management implying responsibility for safety；n. activity involved in maintaining something in good working order
vocabulary.example: Being in poor health, her mother could not care for her children.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 如果母亲的健康状况不好，她就无法照看自己的孩子。

vocabulary.meaning: n.工作；职位；职业；职责
vocabulary.englishDefinition: n. a specific piece of work required to be done as a duty or for a specific fee；. a workplace; as in the expression "on the job";；. an object worked on; a result produced by working；. the responsibility to do something
vocabulary.example: Bond went to many parts of the world because of his job.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 邦德因为他的工作去了世界上很多地方

vocabulary.meaning: v.看；参见；看见；见到
vocabulary.englishDefinition: n. the seat within a bishop's diocese where his cathedral is located；v. perceive by sight or have the power to perceive by sight；v. deem to be；v. be careful or certain to do something; make certain of something
vocabulary.example: On most days of the year, lines of visitors can be seen outside madame Tussaud’s.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 一年中的大多数日子里，杜莎夫人蜡像馆外都排着长队。

vocabulary.meaning: adj.坏的
vocabulary.englishDefinition: n. that which is below standard or expectations as of ethics or decency；a. having undesirable or negative qualities；s. very intense；s. feeling physical discomfort or pain (`tough' is occasionally used colloquially for `bad')
vocabulary.example: It can be of bad quality and badly made.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 它可能质量很差，制作也很糟糕。

vocabulary.meaning: v/n.改变
vocabulary.englishDefinition: n. an event that occurs when something passes from one state or phase to another；n. a relational difference between states; especially between states before and after some event；n. the action of changing something；n. the result of alteration or modification
vocabulary.example: English writing was always easy for me, but that changed on the first day I walked into Mrs. Johnson’s class.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 英语写作对我来说总是很容易，但在我走进约翰逊夫人的课堂的第一天，情况就变了。

vocabulary.meaning: v.来
vocabulary.englishDefinition: v. move toward, travel toward something or somebody or approach something or somebody；v. come to pass; arrive, as in due course；v. reach or enter a state, relation, condition, use, or position；v. to be the product or result
vocabulary.example: When the sun comes out,British people tend to spend time in their garden if they have one.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 当太阳出来的时候，英国人喜欢在花园里消磨时间，如果他们有花园的话。

vocabulary.meaning: n.例子；实例；榜样；范例
vocabulary.englishDefinition: n. an item of information that is typical of a class or group；n. punishment intended as a warning to others
vocabulary.example: For example. the coyote was not native to new England.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 例如，土狼不是新英格兰的本土动物。

vocabulary.meaning: v.（意外或偶然地）发现；找到；找回；（经寻找、研究或思考）发现
vocabulary.englishDefinition: v. come upon, as if by accident; meet with；v. come upon after searching; find the location of something that was missed or lost；v. come to believe on the basis of emotion, intuitions, or indefinite grounds；v. obtain through effort or management
vocabulary.example: Then I realized I needed to find out what I could do to improve my grade and how to use the “tools” in my writing.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 然后我意识到，我需要找出我可以做什么来提高我的成绩，以及如何在我的写作中使用“工具”。

vocabulary.meaning: n.顺序；命令；勋章
vocabulary.englishDefinition: n. (often plural) a command given by a superior (e.g., a military or law enforcement officer) that must be obeyed；n. a degree in a continuum of size or quantity；n. established customary state (especially of society)；n. a commercial document used to request som
vocabulary.example: Greeks gave garlic to athletes during the Olympic Games in order to increase their strength.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 古希腊人在奥林匹克运动会期间会分给运动员大蒜以增加他们的体力。

vocabulary.meaning: pron.哪里 adv.在哪里
vocabulary.englishDefinition: pron. & conj. Whether.；adv. At or in what place; hence, in what situation, position,；or circumstances; -- used interrogatively.；adv. At or in which place; at the place in which; hence, in the；case or instance in which; -- used relatively.
vocabulary.example: Where does he come from?
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 他是哪里人?

vocabulary.meaning: n.身体，躯体，躯干，主要部分
vocabulary.englishDefinition: n. the entire structure of an organism (an animal, plant, or human being)；n. a group of persons associated by some common tie or occupation and regarded as an entity；n. a natural object consisting of a dead animal or person；n. an individual 3-dimensional objec
vocabulary.example: this has been an open secret in keeping your body look and feel young.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 这是一个公开的秘密，让你的身体看起来和感觉年轻。

vocabulary.meaning: vt. 控制; 指挥; 掌管; 支配; ；n. 管制; 管理
vocabulary.englishDefinition: n. power to direct or determine；n. a relation of constraint of one entity (thing or person or group) by another；n. (physiology) regulation or maintenance of a function or action or reflex etc；n. the activity of managing or exerting control over something
vocabulary.example: However，we must always remember that we can control our reactions.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 然而，我们必须总是记住我们可以控制自己的反应。

vocabulary.meaning: adv.非常；许多；大量； pron.许多；大量
vocabulary.englishDefinition: n. a parcel of land having fixed boundaries；. (Old Testament) nephew of Abraham; God destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah but chose to spare Lot and his family who were told to flee without looking back at the destruction；v. divide into lots, as of land, for example
vocabulary.example: The problem is that a lot of baboons will come back to the city to find food again.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 问题是许多狒狒会返回城市，再次寻找食物。

vocabulary.meaning: n.行动；移动；搬家
vocabulary.englishDefinition: n. the act of deciding to do something；n. the act of changing your residence or place of business；n. (game) a player's turn to take some action permitted by the rules of the game；v. cause to move or shift into a new position or place, both in a concrete and in
vocabulary.example: Bond is unable to move in high society.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 邦德不能够进入高层社会。

vocabulary.meaning: prep.从；离开；休息；休假；adv.离；休息
vocabulary.englishDefinition: a. not in operation or operational；s. below a satisfactory level；a. (of events) no longer planned or scheduled；s. in an unpalatable state
vocabulary.example: Both milk and honey are known to ward off harmful bacteria in our body
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 牛奶和蜂蜜都以防御我们身体里的有害病菌而知名。

vocabulary.meaning: v.说；告诉；讲；表达；n.发言权；决定权
vocabulary.englishDefinition: n. the chance to speak；v. communicate or express nonverbally；v. utter aloud；v. state as one's opinion or judgement; declare
vocabulary.example: Reports say that the walkers are mostly from_____.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 报道称，这些步行者大多来自_____。

vocabulary.meaning: adv.再一次，又一次
vocabulary.englishDefinition: r. anew
vocabulary.example: I was again faced with the pressure of making a decision.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 我再一次面临着做决策的压力。

vocabulary.meaning: n.数量，数额
vocabulary.englishDefinition: n. the relative magnitude of something with reference to a criterion；v. be tantamount or equivalent to
vocabulary.example: you will know for sure that you can save a significant amount each year by not driving a car.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 你将会确信地知道你每年可以通过不开车节约可观的费用。

vocabulary.meaning: n.注意，专心
vocabulary.englishDefinition: n. the process whereby a person concentrates on some features of the environment to the (relative) exclusion of others；n. a general interest that leads people to want to know more；n. a courteous act indicating affection；n. the faculty or power of mental concen
vocabulary.example: There is nothing wrong with a little attention from others when you're 11.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 当你11岁的时候，得到别人的一点关注并没有错。

vocabulary.meaning: adj.较好的，更好的
vocabulary.englishDefinition: n. something superior in quality or condition or effect；n. a superior person having claim to precedence；n. the superior one of two alternatives；v. surpass in excellence
vocabulary.example: Scientists who have studied the coyote believe it is better than the wolf at living in human areas.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 研究过土狼的科学家认为，土狼比狼更善于在人类居住的地区生活。

vocabulary.meaning: adv. 其他的; 别的; 另外的；adj. 别的
vocabulary.englishDefinition: a. & pron. Other; one or something beside; as, Who else is； coming? What else shall I give? Do you expect anything else?；adv. & conj. Besides; except that mentioned; in addition; as,； nowhere else; no one else.；adv. & conj. Otherwise; in the other, or the cont
vocabulary.example: It felt strange to be awake while everyone else was asleep.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 其他都睡着的时候自己醒着会感觉很奇怪。

vocabulary.meaning: n.数；数量；号；数字；v.标号；给…编号
vocabulary.englishDefinition: n. the property possessed by a sum or total or indefinite quantity of units or individuals；n. a concept of quantity involving zero and units；n. a select company of people；n. a numeral or string of numerals that is used for identification
vocabulary.example: Most leases limit you to a certain number of miles.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 大多数租赁都会将你限制到几英里内。

vocabulary.meaning: v.转向；转身；翻；转弯 n.转向；转变；转动；旋动
vocabulary.englishDefinition: n. the act of changing or reversing the direction of the course；. (game) the activity of doing something in an agreed succession；. an unforeseen development；. the act of turning away or in the opposite direction
vocabulary.example: we know that if we had to turn to anybody, it would be her.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 我们知道如果我们必须求助于任何人，那就是她。

vocabulary.meaning: adv.好；很 n.井；int.噢；啊；好啦
vocabulary.englishDefinition: n. a deep hole or shaft dug or drilled to obtain water or oil or gas or brine；. a cavity or vessel used to contain liquid；. an abundant source；. an open shaft through the floors of a building (as for a stairway)
vocabulary.example: Honey and milk get along well.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 蜂蜜和牛奶搭配得很好。

vocabulary.meaning: n. 背部，背；adj. 背后的; 后面的; 后部的;；adv. 向后; 在后; 在背面;；v. (使)后退，倒退; 帮助; 支持
vocabulary.englishDefinition: n. the posterior part of a human (or animal) body from the neck to the end of the spine；n. the part of something that is furthest from the normal viewer；n. (football) a person who plays in the backfield；n. the part of a garment that covers the back of your bod
vocabulary.example: After my tea,I got back into bed.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 喝完茶，我就去睡觉了。

vocabulary.meaning: det. 两者，双方;；adj. 两...（都），两个...（都）;；pron. 两个;；conj. 不仅...而且..，...和...都，既...又...;；adv. 在两方面同样地
vocabulary.englishDefinition: s. (used with count nouns) two considered together; the two
vocabulary.example: By and by, I could talk to her both online and in person.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 渐渐地，我可以在网上或当面和她交谈了。

vocabulary.meaning: n.&v.爱；爱情；热爱
vocabulary.englishDefinition: n. a strong positive emotion of regard and affection；. any object of warm affection or devotion;；. a deep feeling of sexual desire and attraction；. a score of zero in tennis or squash
vocabulary.example: Instead，we should love ourselves rather than desire for impossible standards.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 反而，我们应该爱自己，而不是欲求不可能的标准。

vocabulary.meaning: n.学生；大学生；研究生；学者
vocabulary.englishDefinition: n. a learner who is enrolled in an educational institution
vocabulary.example: Some students may decide to leave school at 16.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 一些学生可能决定在16岁离开学校。

vocabulary.meaning: v.走；步行；行走；散步
vocabulary.englishDefinition: n. the act of traveling by foot；. manner of walking；. the act of walking somewhere；. a path set aside for walking
vocabulary.example: For this reason, never walk behind a horse.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 因此，千万不要跟在马后面走。

vocabulary.meaning: n.世界；天下；地球；社会
vocabulary.englishDefinition: n. people in general; especially a distinctive group of people with some shared interest；. all of your experiences that determine how things appear to you；. a part of the earth that can be considered separately；. all of the living human inhabitants of the eart
vocabulary.example: Garlic is now grown everywhere in the world.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 现在世界各地都种大蒜。

vocabulary.meaning: n.能力，才能
vocabulary.englishDefinition: n. the quality of being able to perform; a quality that permits or facilitates achievement or accomplishment；n. possession of the qualities (especially mental qualities) required to do something or get something done
vocabulary.example: This can reduce kids ability to develop good self-esteem.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 这会降低孩子培养良好自尊心的能力。

vocabulary.meaning: v.申请
vocabulary.englishDefinition: v. be pertinent or relevant or applicable；v. ask (for something)；v. refer (a word or name) to a person or thing；v. apply oneself to
vocabulary.example: It is, therefore, very important that parents take all steps required to apply for student loans through the government.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 因此，家长们按照步骤去通过政府申请学生贷款是很重要的。

vocabulary.meaning: v.打破，损坏，打断 n.间歇，休息
vocabulary.englishDefinition: n. an unexpected piece of good luck；n. the occurrence of breaking；n. an abrupt change in the tone or register of the voice (as at puberty or due to emotion)；n. the opening shot that scatters the balls in billiards or pool
vocabulary.example: Nobody is sure how long a plastic bag takes to totally break down.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 没人知道一个塑料需要多久的时间才能完全分解。

vocabulary.meaning: adj.可能的；；adv.有可能
vocabulary.englishDefinition: a. has a good chance of being the case or of coming about；s. expected to become or be; in prospect；s. within the realm of credibility
vocabulary.example: People are less likely to get injured while cycling.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 人们不太可能会在骑自行车的时候受伤。

vocabulary.meaning: adj.活着的；活的；v.“live”的现在分词
vocabulary.englishDefinition: v. lead a certain kind of life; live in a certain style；v. pursue a positive and satisfying existence；a. actually being performed at the time of hearing or viewing；a. exerting force or containing energy
vocabulary.example: At first，we were living in caves，then came the ice age，then the meltdown，and finally, what we are today.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 起初，我们居住在洞穴，然后我们进入了冰河时代，接着又经历了冰川融化，最终，我们变成了我们今天的样子。

vocabulary.meaning: n.母亲
vocabulary.englishDefinition: n. a woman who has given birth to a child (also used as a term of address to your mother)；. a stringy slimy substance consisting of yeast cells and bacteria; forms during fermentation and is added to cider or wine to produce vinegar；. a term of address for an
vocabulary.example: mothers prefer to shop for children's clothes.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 妈妈们更喜欢购物卖孩子的衣服

vocabulary.meaning: v.读；阅读；朗读；读懂
vocabulary.englishDefinition: n. something that is read；v. interpret something that is written or printed；v. have or contain a certain wording or form；v. look at, interpret, and say out loud something that is written or printed
vocabulary.example: As he grew up, George loved to read and learn.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 随着他的成长，乔治喜欢阅读和学习。

vocabulary.meaning: adv.同样 adj.同一的；相同的
vocabulary.englishDefinition: a. same in identity；a. closely similar or comparable in kind or quality or quantity or degree；s. unchanged in character or nature
vocabulary.example: Each had been brought up in the same family.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 他们都是在同一个家庭长大的。

vocabulary.meaning: n. 行动, 行为, 幕, 法案；vi. 行动, 表演, 假装, 见效, 表现, 担当；vt. 扮演, 装作；[计
vocabulary.englishDefinition: n. a legal document codifying the result of deliberations of a committee or society or legislative body；n. something that people do or cause to happen；n. a subdivision of a play or opera or ballet；n. a short theatrical performance that is part of a longer prog
vocabulary.example: act
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: act：n. 行动, 行为, 幕, 法案；vi. 行动, 表演, 假装, 见效, 表现, 担当；vt. 扮演, 装作；[计

vocabulary.meaning: n.机会
vocabulary.englishDefinition: n. a risk involving danger；v. be the case by chance
vocabulary.example: Cycling also carries a relatively low chance of injury.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 骑自行车受伤的几率也相对较低。

vocabulary.meaning: n.交谈，谈话
vocabulary.englishDefinition: n. the use of speech for informal exchange of views or ideas or information etc.
vocabulary.example: however, on long train journeys people have often started a conversation with me for no reason.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 然而，在长途火车旅行中，人们经常无缘无故地和我聊天。

vocabulary.meaning: n. 白天，日间; 一天，一日;；adv. 每天，经常在白天地;；adj. 白昼的, 日间的
vocabulary.englishDefinition: n. time for Earth to make a complete rotation on its axis；n. some point or period in time；n. a day assigned to a particular purpose or observance；n. the time after sunrise and before sunset while it is light outside
vocabulary.example: I drank every day and couldn't stop it.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 我每天都喝醉并且不能停止。

vocabulary.meaning: adj.（长度或距离）长的；（询问或谈论长度或距离）长
vocabulary.englishDefinition: a. primarily temporal sense; being or indicating a relatively great or greater than average duration or passage of time or a duration as specified；a. primarily spatial sense; of relatively great or greater than average spatial extension or extension as specifi
vocabulary.example: In the long run organic farms save energy and protect the environment.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 长久来看，有机农场能节省能量，并且能够保护环境。

vocabulary.meaning: n.方法；方式；途径
vocabulary.englishDefinition: n. how a result is obtained or an end is achieved；n. an instrumentality for accomplishing some end；n. considerable capital (wealth or income)
vocabulary.example: There are many means such as play centers and kindergartens.（
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 早教）有多种方式，如游戏中心和幼儿园。

vocabulary.meaning: n.新闻；消息
vocabulary.englishDefinition: n. information about recent and important events；n. information reported in a newspaper or news magazine；n. informal information of any kind that is not previously known to someone
vocabulary.example: A new study has good news for kids with strong reading skills.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 一项新的研究为具有强大阅读技巧的孩子带来了好消息。

vocabulary.meaning: v.粘贴；刺；忍受；戳 n.条；枯枝；枝条；柴火棍儿
vocabulary.englishDefinition: n. an implement consisting of a length of wood；. a small thin branch of a tree；. a lever used by a pilot to control the ailerons and elevators of an airplane；. a rectangular quarter pound block of butter or margarine
vocabulary.example: Besides, stick to the speed limit, keep your tires properly filled with air, empty your trunk of heavy items, and accelerate and brake gently.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 此外，要严格遵守速度限制，保持轮胎充分充气，把后备箱里的重物清空，并小心加速和刹车。

vocabulary.meaning: adj.薄的；细的；瘦的；稀少的；v.使变淡；变稀疏；变稀少；（使）变稀薄；adv.薄薄地
vocabulary.englishDefinition: v. lose thickness; become thin or thinner；v. make thin or thinner；a. of relatively small extent from one surface to the opposite or in cross section；a. lacking excess flesh
vocabulary.example: Girls may feel like being thin but boys may feel like they don't look big enough.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 女孩可能觉得自己很瘦，但男孩可能觉得自己看起来不够大。

vocabulary.meaning: adv.也；过于；非常；很
vocabulary.englishDefinition: r to a degree exceeding normal or proper limits；r in addition
vocabulary.example: Do you know that if you miss out too much sleep you will die?
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 你知道吗，如果你错过太多的睡眠，你会死的。

vocabulary.meaning: adj.能够的; 有才能的; (某方面)擅长的
vocabulary.englishDefinition: a. (usually followed by `to') having the necessary means or skill or know-how or authority to do something；s. have the skills and qualifications to do things well；s. having inherent physical or mental ability or capacity；s. having a strong healthy body
vocabulary.example: big companies wouldn’t be able to dominate the market...
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 大公司将无法主宰市场...

vocabulary.meaning: prep.反对；与...相反
vocabulary.englishDefinition: prep. Abreast; opposite to; facing; towards; as, against the； mouth of a river; -- in this sense often preceded by over.；prep. From an opposite direction so as to strike or come in； contact with; in contact with; upon; as, hail beats against the roof.；prep. In
vocabulary.example: I grabbed him and pulled him tight against me.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 我抓住他，把他紧紧地拉在我身上。

vocabulary.meaning: v.相信，认为
vocabulary.englishDefinition: v. accept as true; take to be true；v. be confident about something；v. follow a credo; have a faith; be a believer；v. credit with veracity
vocabulary.example: They believed that helping others was their brotherly duty.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 他们认为帮助他人是他们作为兄弟的职责。

vocabulary.meaning: adj. 最好的; 最出色的; 最优秀的; ；adv. 最; 最高程度地; 最出色地; 最高标准地; 最适合地; 最恰当地;；n. 最好的事物(或人)
vocabulary.englishDefinition: n. the supreme effort one can make；n. the person who is most outstanding or excellent; someone who tops all others；n. Canadian physiologist (born in the United States) who assisted F. G. Banting in research leading to the discovery of insulin (1899-1978)
vocabulary.example: It is best known to induce sleep. So take it regularly if you have sleeping problems.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 它最著名的作用是诱导睡眠。所以如果你有睡眠问题，请定期服用。

vocabulary.meaning: vt.带来
vocabulary.englishDefinition: v. take something or somebody with oneself somewhere；v. cause to come into a particular state or condition；v. cause to happen or to occur as a consequence；v. go or come after and bring or take back
vocabulary.example: Quitting your fitness routine can bring negative effects to your body and your brain as well.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 放弃健身计划会给你的身体和大脑带来负面影响。

vocabulary.meaning: n.父亲；爸爸
vocabulary.englishDefinition: n. a male parent (also used as a term of address to your father)；. `Father' is a term of address for priests in some churches (especially the Roman Catholic Church or the Orthodox Catholic Church); `Padre' is frequently used in the military；. a person who hold
vocabulary.example: When Deborah was just a young girl, her father left and went off to sea.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 当黛博拉还是个小女孩时，她的父亲离开了她，去航海了。

vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 我决心把生活中美好的事情列出来。

vocabulary.meaning: a. 健康的, 有益健康的, 卫生的；健康的
vocabulary.englishDefinition: a. having or indicating good health in body or mind; free from infirmity or disease；s. financially secure and functioning well；s. promoting health; healthful；s. exercising or showing good judgment
vocabulary.example: George: Doctor, what is the best way to stay healthy?
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 教材原句理解：本句包含 “healthy”，核心义为“a. 健康的, 有益健康的, 卫生的；健康的”。

vocabulary.meaning: n.房子；房屋；v.安置；收藏
vocabulary.englishDefinition: n. a dwelling that serves as living quarters for one or more families；. the members of a religious community living together；. the audience gathered together in a theatre or cinema；. an official assembly having legislative powers
vocabulary.example: This enables elderly people to remain in their own houses.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 这使得老年人可以呆在自己的房子里。

vocabulary.meaning: a. 最后的, 末尾的, 最近的；vi. 持续, 支持, 维持；vt. 使维持, 够...用；adv. 最后, 后
vocabulary.englishDefinition: n. the last or lowest in an ordering or series；n. a person's dying act; the final thing a person can do；n. a unit of weight equal to 4,000 pounds；n. a unit of capacity for grain equal to 80 bushels
vocabulary.example: The next part of the race is every hurdle between the first and last one.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 教材原句理解：本句包含 “last”，核心义为“a. 最后的, 末尾的, 最近的；vi. 持续, 支持, 维持；vt. 使维持, 够...用；adv. 最后, 后”。

vocabulary.meaning: v.让
vocabulary.englishDefinition: n. a serve that strikes the net before falling into the receiver's court; the ball must be served again；v. make it possible through a specific action or lack of action for something to happen；v. actively cause something to happen；v. leave unchanged
vocabulary.example: Eventually, I just let my mind go free.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 最终，我只能让自己大脑放松。

vocabulary.meaning: n.水平；级别
vocabulary.englishDefinition: n. height above ground；. indicator that establishes the horizontal when a bubble is centered in a tube of liquid；. an abstract place usually conceived as having depth；v. aim at
vocabulary.example: They need to find ways to increase their production levels.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 他们需要找办法增加生产水平。

vocabulary.meaning: v.住；居住；生存；过日子；adj.活的；现场直播的
vocabulary.englishDefinition: v. lead a certain kind of life; live in a certain style；v. pursue a positive and satisfying existence；a. actually being performed at the time of hearing or viewing；a. exerting force or containing energy
vocabulary.example: The few people who live in the desert live in oasis(
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 绿洲).居住在沙漠地区的一些人都住在绿洲附近。

vocabulary.meaning: n.名称；名字；名声；名誉；v.命名；任命；给…取名
vocabulary.englishDefinition: n. a language unit by which a person or thing is known；n. a person's reputation；n. family based on male descent；n. a well-known or notable person
vocabulary.example: He has had a ship named after him.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 他有一艘以他的名字命名的轮船。

vocabulary.meaning: adj.典型的；正常的
vocabulary.englishDefinition: a. conforming with or constituting a norm or standard or level or type or social norm; not abnormal；a. in accordance with scientific laws；a. being approximately average or within certain limits in e.g. intelligence and development；s. forming a right angle
vocabulary.example: Even though these rats are eating food, their bodies can't process it in the normal way.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 即使这些老鼠进食，它们的身体也无法正常消化这些食物。

vocabulary.meaning: adv.&n.现在；adj.现在的
vocabulary.englishDefinition: n. the momentary present；r. in the historical present; at this point in the narration of a series of past events；r. used to preface a command or reproof or request；r. at the present moment
vocabulary.example: There are more wild pigs in Berlin now than in the past.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 柏林现在相比以前有更多的野猪。

vocabulary.meaning: n. 办公室, 部, 公职, 职责；办公室
vocabulary.englishDefinition: n. place of business where professional or clerical duties are performed；. (of a government or government official) holding an office means being in power；. professional or clerical workers in an office；. a religious rite or service prescribed by ecclesiastica
vocabulary.example: A) To have a rest on his way to the office.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 教材原句理解：本句包含 “office”，核心义为“n. 办公室, 部, 公职, 职责；办公室”。

vocabulary.meaning: n. 意见, 评价, 主张；意见
vocabulary.englishDefinition: n. a personal belief or judgment that is not founded on proof or certainty；n. a message expressing a belief about something; the expression of a belief that is held with confidence but not substantiated by positive knowledge or proof；n. the legal document stat
vocabulary.example: What is the author's opinion on the result of a race?
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 教材原句理解：本句包含 “opinion”，核心义为“n. 意见, 评价, 主张；意见”。

vocabulary.meaning: n.权力；力量；动力；能力
vocabulary.englishDefinition: n. possession of controlling influence；. (physics) the rate of doing work; measured in watts (= joules/second)；. one possessing or exercising power or influence or authority；v. supply the force or power for the functioning of
vocabulary.example: The power of positive thinking lies in belief.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 积极思考的力量在于信念。

vocabulary.meaning: a. 有力的, 有权力的, 强大的；强力的
vocabulary.englishDefinition: a. having great power or force or potency or effect
vocabulary.example: powerful
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: powerful：a. 有力的, 有权力的, 强大的；强力的

vocabulary.meaning: v.保护；防护；（制定法律）保护
vocabulary.englishDefinition: v. shield from danger, injury, destruction, or damage；v. use tariffs to favor domestic industry
vocabulary.example: Children deal with stress in both healthy and unhealthy ways.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 孩子们处理压力的方式有健康的也有不健康的。

vocabulary.meaning: n. 目的, 意向, 决心, 用途, 效果, 论题；vt. 意欲, 企图, 计划
vocabulary.englishDefinition: n. an anticipated outcome that is intended or that guides your planned actions；v. reach a decision
vocabulary.example: He found the purpose of his existence, and also the purpose in his circumstance.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 教材原句理解：本句包含 “purpose”，核心义为“n. 目的, 意向, 决心, 用途, 效果, 论题；vt. 意欲, 企图, 计划”。

vocabulary.meaning: n.成功；胜利；发财；成名
vocabulary.englishDefinition: n. an event that accomplishes its intended purpose；n. an attainment that is successful；n. a state of prosperity or fame
vocabulary.example: Have you ever heard of someone who achieves success without making any mistakes?
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 你听说过没有犯任何错误就获得成功的人吗?

vocabulary.meaning: v.支持；支护；支撑；支援 n.支持；支护；支撑；支承
vocabulary.englishDefinition: n. the activity of providing for or maintaining by supplying with money or necessities；n. aiding the cause or policy or interests of；n. something providing immaterial assistance to a person or cause or interest；n. a military operation (often involving new supp
vocabulary.example: I was unable to support my family.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 我无法养活我的家人。

vocabulary.meaning: adv.因此
vocabulary.englishDefinition: r. (used to introduce a logical conclusion) from that fact or reason or as a result
vocabulary.example: Therefore,they are under a lot of stress.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 因此，他们承受着很大的压力。

vocabulary.meaning: n.真理；事实；真实；真实性
vocabulary.englishDefinition: n. a fact that has been verified；. conformity to reality or actuality；. a true statement；. United States abolitionist and feminist who was freed from slavery and became a leading advocate of the abolition of slavery and for the rights of women (1797-1883)
vocabulary.example: High grades help students know the truth of themselves.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 高分帮助学生了解自己的真相。

vocabulary.meaning: n.尝试；试图；努力；v.试图；想要；设法；努力
vocabulary.englishDefinition: v. make an effort or attempt；v. give pain or trouble to；v. test the limits of；v. melt (fat or lard) in order to separate out impurities
vocabulary.example: But you should not try to solve every problem for your child.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 但你不应该试图为孩子解决所有问题。

vocabulary.meaning: adj.特别的；不寻常的；罕见的；独特的
vocabulary.englishDefinition: a. not usual or common or ordinary；s. not commonly encountered
vocabulary.example: The scene ahead looked unusual.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 前方的景象看起来不同寻常。

vocabulary.meaning: n.水；水域
vocabulary.englishDefinition: n. binary compound that occurs at room temperature as a clear colorless odorless tasteless liquid; freezes into ice below 0 degrees centigrade and boils above 100 degrees centigrade; widely used as a solvent；. once thought to be one of four elements composing
vocabulary.example: Getting water seems so easy for many people.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 对许多人来说，取水似乎很容易。

vocabulary.meaning: a. 学院的, 学术的, 不切实际的；. 大学生, 大学教师, 学者, 学会会员
vocabulary.englishDefinition: a. associated with academia or an academy；s. hypothetical or theoretical and not expected to produce an immediate or practical result；s. marked by a narrow focus on or display of learning especially its trivial aspects
vocabulary.example: academic
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: academic：a. 学院的, 学术的, 不切实际的；. 大学生, 大学教师, 学者, 学会会员

vocabulary.meaning: n.行动，行为
vocabulary.englishDefinition: n. something done (usually as opposed to something said)；n. the state of being active；n. the series of events that form a plot；n. the trait of being active and energetic and forceful
vocabulary.example: you can start with a small action.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 你可以从一个小动作开始。

vocabulary.meaning: adv.prep.围绕，环绕
vocabulary.englishDefinition: r. by a circular or circuitous route；r. in a circle or circular motion；r. to a particular destination either specified or understood；r. in circumference
vocabulary.example: Children usually sit at desks or around the kitchen tables.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 孩子们通常坐在课桌边或者厨房的餐桌边。

vocabulary.meaning: n.作者
vocabulary.englishDefinition: v. be the author of
vocabulary.example: What does the author say about dog training?
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 关于犬类训练作者说了些什么？

vocabulary.meaning: v.出生，诞生，产生 adj.天生的
vocabulary.englishDefinition: n. British nuclear physicist (born in Germany) honored for his contributions to quantum mechanics (1882-1970)；a. brought into existence
vocabulary.example: Others were born on the streets and have always lived there.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 其他人则是出生在大街上并且生活在那里。

vocabulary.meaning: v.选择，挑选
vocabulary.englishDefinition: v. pick out, select, or choose from a number of alternatives；v. select as an alternative over another；v. see fit or proper to act in a certain way; decide to act in a certain way
vocabulary.example: Deciding whom you choose as your friends says as much about you as it does them.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 决定你选择谁作为你的朋友，既能反映你自己，也能反映他们。

vocabulary.meaning: n.比较，对比，相比
vocabulary.englishDefinition: n. the act of examining resemblances；. relation based on similarities and differences；. qualities that are comparable
vocabulary.example: here are limited choices at price comparison websites.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 这里是比价网站上有限的选择。

vocabulary.meaning: n. 饮食；vi. 进特种饮食，节食;；vt. 让…按规定进食; 用节食减轻(off)
vocabulary.englishDefinition: n. a prescribed selection of foods；. a legislative assembly in certain countries (e.g., Japan)；. the usual food and drink consumed by an organism (person or animal)；. the act of restricting your food intake (or your intake of particular foods)
vocabulary.example: Ensure you get eight to nine hours of sleep every day and have a well-balanced diet.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 确保你每天有八到九个小时的睡眠会均衡的饮食。

vocabulary.meaning: n.狗
vocabulary.englishDefinition: n. a member of the genus Canis (probably descended from the common wolf) that has been domesticated by man since prehistoric times; occurs in many breeds；. informal term for a man
vocabulary.example: If they tried to escape they were hunted down with dogs.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 如果他们试图逃跑他们就会被警犬逮捕。

vocabulary.meaning: v.吃，咬，蛀; 侵蚀; 烦扰
vocabulary.englishDefinition: v. take in solid food；v. eat a meal; take a meal；v. worry or cause anxiety in a persistent way
vocabulary.example: They eat flowers and plants and dig in gardens and parks in the city.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 他们吃花和植物，在城市的花园和公园里挖掘。

vocabulary.meaning: v.享受
vocabulary.englishDefinition: v. derive or receive pleasure from; get enjoyment from; take pleasure in；v. have benefit from；v. have for one's benefit
vocabulary.example: Organic farming enjoys many advantages.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 有机农业有许多优点。

vocabulary.meaning: n.大事；发生的事情
vocabulary.englishDefinition: n. something that happens at a given place and time；n. a special set of circumstances；n. a phenomenon located at a single point in space-time; the fundamental observational entity in relativity theory
vocabulary.example: Kilts are for special occasions, such as weddings, funerals and other big and important events.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 苏格兰短裙是在特殊场合穿的，比如婚礼、葬礼和其他重大的活动。

vocabulary.meaning: pron.人人；所有人；每人
vocabulary.englishDefinition: n. Everybody; -- commonly separated, every one.
vocabulary.example: He met teachers and school officials,talked to everyone about his dream and never hesitated to tell them what he was after.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 他会见了老师和学校官员，和每个人谈论他的梦想，并毫不犹豫地告诉他们他在追求什么。

vocabulary.meaning: adv.远；远远；大大；久；adj.较远的；远端的
vocabulary.englishDefinition: a. located at a great distance in time or space or degree；s. being of a considerable distance or length；s. being the animal or vehicle on the right or being on the right side of an animal or vehicle；s. beyond a norm in opinion or actions
vocabulary.example: Yet the reality many small business owners face is far less attractive—financial stress, long working hours and unclear boundaries between work and family life.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 然而，许多小企业主面临的现实远没有这么有吸引力——财务压力、长时间工作以及工作和家庭生活之间界限不清。

vocabulary.meaning: adj.联邦制的
vocabulary.englishDefinition: n. a member of the Union Army during the American Civil War；. any federal law-enforcement officer；s. national; especially in reference to the government of the United States as distinct from that of its member units；a. of or relating to the central government
vocabulary.example: Federal Student Aid is an office providing(provide)student loans for higher education.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 联邦学生援助是一个为高等教育提供学生贷款的机构。

vocabulary.meaning: adj.满的；充满的；满是…的
vocabulary.englishDefinition: v. beat for the purpose of cleaning and thickening；v. make (a garment) fuller by pleating or gathering；a. containing as much or as many as is possible or normal；s. complete in extent or degree and in every particular
vocabulary.example: It was a decision full of fear and anxiety for me.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 对我来说，这是一个充满恐惧和焦虑的决定。

vocabulary.meaning: n.将军；（陆军、海军陆战队或美国空军）上将；adj.全体的；普遍的；总的；正常的
vocabulary.englishDefinition: n. a general officer of the highest rank；n. the head of a religious order or congregation；n. a fact about the whole (as opposed to particular)；v. command as a general
vocabulary.example: Some people said she even met General George Washington before she left.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 有人说，她甚至在离开前见到了乔治·华盛顿将军。

vocabulary.meaning: n. 头, 头脑, 领袖, 脑袋, 最前的部分；vt. 为首, 朝向, 前进, 用头顶；vi. 朝特定方向行进, (作物)结穗；a. 头的, 在顶端的, 主要的；磁头; 冲头
vocabulary.englishDefinition: n. the upper part of the human body or the front part of the body in animals; contains the face and brains；. a single domestic animal；. a person who is in charge；. the front of a military formation or procession
vocabulary.example: President's position as head of state.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 教材原句理解：本句包含 “head”，核心义为“n. 头, 头脑, 领袖, 脑袋, 最前的部分；vt. 为首, 朝向, 前进, 用头顶；vi. 朝特定方向行进, (作物)结穗；a. 头的, 在顶端的, 主要的；磁头; 冲头”。

vocabulary.meaning: n.抓；握；拿；支撑 v.拿着；抓住；抱住；托住
vocabulary.englishDefinition: n. power by which something or someone is affected or dominated；. a stronghold；. a cell in a jail or prison；v. have or hold in one's hands or grip
vocabulary.example: This is a gift I still hold in my heart.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 这是我一直珍藏在心里的礼物。

vocabulary.meaning: n.医院
vocabulary.englishDefinition: n. a health facility where patients receive treatment；. a medical institution where sick or injured people are given medical or surgical care
vocabulary.example: Once he caught a fever and had to go to the hospital.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 有一次他发烧了，不得不去医院。

vocabulary.meaning: n.身份；同一性；一致；特征
vocabulary.englishDefinition: n. the distinct personality of an individual regarded as a persisting entity；n. the individual characteristics by which a thing or person is recognized or known；n. an operator that leaves unchanged the element on which it operates；n. exact sameness
vocabulary.example: This helps develop their personal and cultural identity.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 这有助于发展他们的个人和文化认同。

vocabulary.meaning: n.病；（某种）病
vocabulary.englishDefinition: n. impairment of normal physiological function affecting part or all of an organism
vocabulary.example: Crop illness may happen very often.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 作物病害可能经常发生。

vocabulary.meaning: a. 给人深刻印象的, 威严的
vocabulary.englishDefinition: a. making a strong or vivid impression；s. producing a strong effect
vocabulary.example: impressive
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: impressive：a. 给人深刻印象的, 威严的

vocabulary.meaning: n. 液体, 流体, 流音；a. 液体的, 透明的, 明亮的, 流动的, 易变的
vocabulary.englishDefinition: n. a substance that is liquid at room temperature and pressure；. the state in which a substance exhibits a characteristic readiness to flow with little or no tendency to disperse and relatively high incompressibility；. fluid matter having no fixed shape but a
vocabulary.example: liquid
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: liquid：n. 液体, 流体, 流音；a. 液体的, 透明的, 明亮的, 流动的, 易变的

vocabulary.meaning: n.损失；丢失
vocabulary.englishDefinition: n. something that is lost；. gradual decline in amount or activity；. the act of losing someone or something；. the disadvantage that results from losing something
vocabulary.example: They experience failure and loss and let their emotions rule their decisions.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 他们经历了失败和损失，并且情感用事。

vocabulary.meaning: n.纸；纸张；论文；文件
vocabulary.englishDefinition: n. a material made of cellulose pulp derived mainly from wood or rags or certain grasses；. a medium for written communication；. a scholarly article describing the results of observations or stating hypotheses；v. cover with paper
vocabulary.example: In the days of the Internet, there is really no need for such a large amount of paper to be wasted.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 在互联网时代，确实没必要浪费这么多的纸张。

vocabulary.meaning: n.植物；工厂
vocabulary.englishDefinition: n. buildings for carrying on industrial labor；. (botany) a living organism lacking the power of locomotion；. an actor situated in the audience whose acting is rehearsed but seems spontaneous to the audience；. something planted secretly for discovery by another
vocabulary.example: Planting a garden is a lot like having a family.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 种植花园很像组建家庭。

vocabulary.meaning: n.快乐；高兴；愉快；乐事
vocabulary.englishDefinition: n. a fundamental feeling that is hard to define but that people desire to experience；n. a formal expression；n. an activity that affords enjoyment；n. sexual gratification
vocabulary.example: Instead of appreciating material wealth, be thankful for the loved ones in your life and enjoy the little pleasures of life that come your way.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 与其欣赏物质财富，不如感谢你生命中所爱的人，享受生活中出现的小快乐。

vocabulary.meaning: n.点；观点；要点；重点；v.指向；指点；瞄准；指引
vocabulary.englishDefinition: n. a geometric element that has position but no extension；n. the precise location of something; a spatially limited location；n. a brief version of the essential meaning of something；n. an instant of time
vocabulary.example: I was getting very frustrated by this point!
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 我对此感到非常沮丧!

vocabulary.meaning: adj.私有的；私用的；自用的
vocabulary.englishDefinition: n. an enlisted man of the lowest rank in the Army or Marines；a. confined to particular persons or groups or providing privacy；s. concerning things deeply private and personal
vocabulary.example: Private banking has a long tradition in the country.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 私人银行在这个国家有着悠久的传统。

vocabulary.meaning: adv.大概；几乎肯定；很可能
vocabulary.englishDefinition: r. with considerable certainty; without much doubt
vocabulary.example: People do not wear kilts every day probably because of their ______.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 人们不是每天都穿苏格兰裙可能是因为他们的______。

vocabulary.meaning: adv.很；相当；非常；完全
vocabulary.englishDefinition: r. to a degree (not used with a negative)；r. to the greatest extent; completely；r. of an unusually noticeable or exceptional or remarkable kind (not used with a negative)；r. actually or truly or to an extreme
vocabulary.example: The water can be quite cold, though, and that's why quite a lot of people prefer to go abroad for their summer holiday instead.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 不过，那里的水很冷，这就是为什么很多人宁愿去国外度暑假的原因。

vocabulary.meaning: v.设置；放；树立；安排；n.集；集合；一套；电视机
vocabulary.englishDefinition: n. a group of things of the same kind that belong together and are so used；n. (mathematics) an abstract collection of numbers or symbols；n. several exercises intended to be done in series；n. an unofficial association of people or groups
vocabulary.example: A. set a goal A .
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 设定目标

vocabulary.meaning: adj.类似的；相像的；相仿的
vocabulary.englishDefinition: a. marked by correspondence or resemblance；s. (of words) expressing closely related meanings
vocabulary.example: You may choose your friends based on similar interests.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 你可以根据相似的兴趣爱好来选择朋友。

vocabulary.meaning: conj.因为；由于；既然；从…以后；adv.此后；后来；自…以后；从…以来

vocabulary.meaning: v.允许，准许

vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 如果你向医生或者你的祖母求教关于失眠的解决办法。

vocabulary.meaning: adj.有吸引力的，诱人的

vocabulary.meaning: adj.意识到的，察觉到的

vocabulary.meaning: n.盒子 v.（拳击）击打某人

vocabulary.meaning: n.建筑物，房子

vocabulary.meaning: v.购买

vocabulary.meaning: adj.肯定的，确定的 ；pron.某些
vocabulary.englishDefinition: s. definite but not specified or identified；a. having or feeling no doubt or uncertainty; confident and assured；a. established beyond doubt or question; definitely known；a. certain to occur; destined or inevitable

vocabulary.exampleTranslation: 为什么我们总是买某些名牌的鞋子或衣服?

vocabulary.meaning: n. 边缘, 尖锐, 刀刃, 优势；vt. 使锐利, 挤进, 镶边；vi. 缓缓移动
